newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan T$30 bln bond auction changed to March 7.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan T$30 bln bond auction changed to March 7.

text.p: The finance ministry said on Thursday it will auction T$30 billion in 15-year construction bonds on March 7 to cope with money demand for public construction projects.
Official issuance date for the bonds was set for March 11, the ministry said in a statement.
Coupon rate for the bonds was 6.9 percent per annum, it said.
The statement revised the ministry's initial decision on Wednesday to auction T$30 billion in 10-year construction bonds on March 11, with issuance date on March 14.
The ministry will commission the central bank to conduct the bond auction, an official said.
